query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 614 AND 618),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 614 AND 618),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 614 AND 618),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 614 AND 618),'options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 614 AND 618),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 614 AND 618),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0614-0618:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE d.entity_type='fact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id=d.entity_id AND f.source_page BETWEEN 614 AND 618))) AS batch_counts LIMIT 1;
